# Distinct hover/select card states and stationary Open live in Examples

Graduated from: Discussion #21670 (`[GRADUATED_TO_TICKET]`)
Supersedes: #21609 (vetoed via `D+S` & closed), #21606 (closed `NOT_PLANNED`)
Parent Epic: #21140
Decision Record: Not needed
Decision Record impact: none

> **Ownership rationale:** Self-assigned directly (`good first issue` / `help wanted` omitted) because `@tobiu` vetoed `#21609` and requested immediate delivery + 4-state visual review frames ahead of the Sunday `#21140` Engine 14 lock.

## Context

`@tobiu` vetoed `#21609` (`D+S` — Drop+Supersede, [`IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABpEcIxg`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21609#issuecomment-7051086022)) after inspecting `/examples` cards: disabling mouse selection hid five visual and interaction regressions rather than restoring the original `Hover × Selected` chromatic state grammar, fixing the moving-target `"Open live ↗"` CTA, pruning obsolete browser labels, or keeping covers visible. [Discussion #21670](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/21670) converged unanimously across all three active model families (`Gemini` `@neo-gemini-julia`, `Claude Opus` `@neo-opus-ada` + `@neo-opus-vega`, and `GPT` `@neo-gpt-euclid`).

## The Problem

1. **Lost orthogonal `(Hover × Selected)` cover gradient (`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs:327-337`, `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css:67-75`):** `getBackgroundImageStyle()` writes `url(...), linear-gradient(var(--portal-examples-list-gradient-start), var(--portal-examples-list-gradient-end))`, which sits invisible behind `url(...)` because `List.css` dropped `@property` declarations and `background-blend-mode: overlay` from `6fea520d4d:resources/scss/src/apps/portal/examples/List.scss:1-47`.
2. **Hover and Select mapped `1:1` to the same drawer (`List.css:158-174`)**, hiding ~84%–94% of covers behind an opaque slab (`List.css:79`).
3. **Moving-target `"Open live ↗"` CTA (`List.css:49, 146-174`):** Entering a card from below expanded `.portal-example-more` under `.portal-example-title-row`, pushing `"Open live ↗"` ~120 px away from the cursor, while `translateY(-2px)` shifted every hitbox by 2 px.
4. **Zero-entropy browser string (`List.mjs:241-244`):** `0 / 126` records in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` override `"Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari"`, whereas `9 / 126` explicitly qualify `['Desktop', 'Mobile']` (`2 / 9` also have `sharedWorkers`).
5. **Link focus vs card selection (`src/list/Base.mjs:355`, `src/main/addon/Navigator.mjs:128-136, 193-259, 468-470`):** Enabling `selectOnFocus: true` sets `autoClick: true`, firing a synthetic click on card `B`'s wrapper during `focusin` before `B`'s native `<a>` click runs; meanwhile default `Navigator` steps `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` by `±1` instead of crossing rows in multi-column CSS grids.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: "the OLD exaples list => it had a blue gradient for HOVERED items visually mixing into the cover image. it had a green background gradient for selected items. an item could have both: hovered and selected, leading to a new custom gradient. of course we need BOTH states and not hacking around... the idea that a list item gets a cover that expands is not bad. but it can not be 1:1 the same for hover and select... i enter an item with the mouse from the bottom, since i want to click the link. the details expand to the top, the link moves AWAY from the cursor. serious UX fail. all examples have support for all browsers at this point. showing them => fail. hiding 80% of a cover for details.... not nice."` (`@tobiu` veto on `#21609` + [`IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABpEcIxg`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21609#issuecomment-7051086022), plus `@tobiu` clarification relayed in [`IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABpFueYw`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21676#issuecomment-7052435043): *"i only challenged the team to do better"* — present distinct 4-state visual candidates on top of the converged interaction contract rather than treating the 2025 palette as a literal restoration order).
- **Named container query (`container: examples-list / inline-size` on `.portal-examples-list.neo-list`):** Overview (`padding: 0`), GroupPage (`padding-inline: 24px`), SearchResults (`padding: 0`), and standalone (`padding-inline: 16px`) apply different horizontal paddings, while `.content` (`List.css:62`) declares its own inner `container-type: inline-size`. Naming `container: examples-list / inline-size` on `ul.portal-examples-list` and querying `@container examples-list (min-width: 704px)` (`2 × 340px + 24px gap` inside `ul`'s content box, equivalent to `736px` on a `32px`-padded wrapper) switches modes at the exact 1-column ↔ 2-column boundary (`900 px` and `641 px` sidebar layouts stay 1-column).
- **Shared Portal hover token (`DC_kwDODSospM4BLeWS`):** Source `OQ1`'s blue hover stop from `var(--sem-color-border-focus)` (`var(--purple-400)` = `#3E63DD` in `theme-neo-dark` & `theme-neo-light`), matching `#21674` glass cards.
- **Single arrow-key owner (`DC_kwDODSospM4BLeWS`, `DC_kwDODSospM4BLeXo`):** Configure `navigator: {workerKeys: ['ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp']}` and `selectOnFocus: false` on `Portal.view.examples.List`; `Portal.view.examples.ListModel` owns body-click toggle (ignoring `tagName === 'a'` in `data.path`), `Escape` (`deselectAll()`), `Left`/`Right` (`±1`), and `Up`/`Down` geometric row traversal via `view.getDomRect()` + `Neo.main.addon.Navigator.navigateTo` (handling uniform 3-column, 2-column, `leadCard: true` `2×2` hero, and 1-column layouts).

## The Fix

<!-- binding-inventory: target-files -->
- `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs`
- `apps/portal/view/examples/ListModel.mjs`
- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css`
- `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/apps/portal/examples/List.css`
- `resources/css/theme-neo-light/apps/portal/examples/List.css`
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/ListModel.spec.mjs`
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs`
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`
<!-- /binding-inventory -->

1. **`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs`:** Wire `selectionModel: ListModel`, `selectOnFocus: false`, and `navigator: {workerKeys: ['ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp']}`. Structure non-tile cards into two zones:
   - `.preview-image-wrap` (`aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; position: relative; overflow: hidden`): `.preview-image`, top-left `.portal-example-group-badge` (when `showGroup`), top-right `.neo-multi-window` pill (when `record.sharedWorkers`), and `.portal-example-more` (rendered inside `.preview-image-wrap` for `@container examples-list (min-width: 704px)` / reordered via flex/grid order or CSS grid placement below `.portal-example-footer` at `< 704px`! Specifically: make `.content` a 2-row CSS Grid `grid-template-rows: auto auto` where `.preview-image-wrap` and `.portal-example-more` share grid cell `1 / 1` (`align-self: end; max-height: 40%; z-index: 2`) at `@container examples-list (min-width: 704px)` and `.portal-example-more` moves to grid row `3` below `.portal-example-footer` at `@container examples-list (max-width: 703.98px)` — one DOM node, zero duplication!).
   - `.portal-example-footer`: stationary surface rail with `.portal-example-title-row` (`.neo-title` link + `.neo-github-image` source link + `.portal-example-open-cue` `"Open live ↗"`) and 2-line `.portal-example-feature`.
   - Prune `browsers` from `createItemContent`; render `.portal-example-mobile` chip (`"Mobile"`) inside `.portal-example-more` only when `record.environments?.includes('Mobile')` (`9 / 126` records).
2. **`apps/portal/view/examples/ListModel.mjs`:** Extend `Neo.selection.ListModel` (`Portal.view.examples.ListModel`):
   - `onListClick(data)`: return early when `data.path?.some(el => el.tagName === 'a')`; otherwise toggle `isSelected(itemId) ? deselect(itemId) : select(itemId)` and sync `Navigator.navigateTo` when needed.
   - `onKeyDownLeft` / `onKeyDownRight`: step `±1` across navigable records, selecting and calling `Neo.main.addon.Navigator.navigateTo`.
   - `onKeyDownUp` / `onKeyDownDown`: query `view.getDomRect(itemIds)` to move to the overlapping/nearest card in the previous/next visual row (crossing a row in 3-column and `2×2` `leadCard` grids, stepping `±1` in 1-column), selecting and calling `Neo.main.addon.Navigator.navigateTo`.
   - `onKeyDownEscape`: call `deselectAll()`.
3. **`resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css` & `theme-neo-{dark,light}/apps/portal/examples/List.css`:**
   - Apply the [design ruling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21676#issuecomment-7069191068) across `Rest`, `Hovered`, `Selected`, and `Hovered + Selected` (hard-light pointer reflection and entry glint, persistent green selection ring and disclosure, independent neutral keyboard focus ring, and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` support).
   - Remove `transform: translateY(-2px)` from `.neo-list-item:hover` (`0.0 px` hitbox displacement).
   - Cap `.portal-example-more` at `max-height: 40%` on `.neo-selected` (`@container examples-list (min-width: 704px)`) with `<= #3B` dark neutral surface (`rgba(13, 16, 22, 0.88)`) for `>= 4.5:1` WCAG AA contrast; keep `0fr` → `1fr` in-flow below `.portal-example-footer` at `@container examples-list (max-width: 703.98px)`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Orthogonal 4-state visual grammar & focus visibility):** Non-tile cards render four visually distinct states (`Rest`, `Hovered`, `Selected`, `Hovered + Selected`) in both `neo-dark` and `neo-light`, per the [design ruling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21676#issuecomment-7069191068). Keyboard focus is a neutral ring in every state, with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` support.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Stationary `"Open live ↗"` & neighbor hit-target preservation):** In multi-column layouts (`@container examples-list (min-width: 704px)` — verified at `1440 × 900`, `1024 × 800`, and boundary `704 px` list content width), bottom-entry hover, same-card selection, and cross-row selection transfer produce **`0.0 px` viewport shift** (`getBoundingClientRect()`) on `.neo-title`, `.neo-github-image`, and `.portal-example-open-cue`, AND `document.elementFromPoint` `25 px` into row `N+1`'s cover resolves to row `N+1`'s card (`0 px` neighbor overlap).
- [ ] **AC-3 (Cover-first geometry & 1-column container fallback):** `100%` of the `16:9` cover is unoccluded on Rest and Hover (and in 1-column `< 704 px` list widths even when Selected); on the single `.neo-selected` card at `>= 704 px`, `.portal-example-more` stays `<= 40%` of `.preview-image-wrap` height with `>= 4.5:1` text contrast (measured on a dark and on a light cover in both themes). At `< 704 px` list content width (`900 × 800` sidebar 1-col, `641 × 800`, and `390 × 844`), `.portal-example-more` expands in-flow below `.portal-example-footer` while neighbor covers remain clickable.
- [ ] **AC-4 (Metadata pruning):** Zero cards render `"Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari"` or standalone `"Desktop"`; `Grid Big Data` (`environments: ['Desktop', 'Mobile']`) renders the `Mobile` qualification in `.portal-example-more` without `Multi-window`, while `Workstation` (`sharedWorkers: true`, desktop-only) renders `Multi-window` without `Mobile` (`0` edits to `examples.json`).
- [ ] **AC-5 (Link-focus isolation & grid keyboard navigation):** With card `A` selected, clicking card `B`'s `.neo-title`, `.portal-example-open-cue`, or `.neo-github-image` (including nested child nodes) activates once and **leaves `A` selected**; clicking `A`'s card body or pressing `Escape` clears selection; `Title` → `Tab` → `GitHub` works with zero focusable elements inside `.portal-example-more`; `ArrowDown` crosses a visual row at `1440 × 900` (including around Featured's `2×2` `leadCard`) and steps `+1` at `900 × 800` 1-column, keeping DOM focus and `.neo-selected` on the same card.
- [ ] **AC-6 (Visual evidence & `## Cold look`):** PR body includes side-by-side **Rest / Hovered / Selected / Hovered + Selected** captures across dark + white covers (`1440 × 900`, `900 × 800` sidebar 1-col, `390 × 844` in `neo-dark` & `neo-light`) plus a two-reader swapped-order `## Cold look`.

## Out of Scope

- Modifying `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, `MainContainer.mjs`, or `GroupPage.mjs` ahead of Sunday's `#21140` lock.

## Avoided Traps

- **`selectOnFocus: true` on `Portal.view.examples.List`:** Sets `Navigator` `autoClick: true`, causing `focusin` on card `B`'s `<a>` to synthesize a click on `B`'s wrapper and steal selection (`DC_kwDODSospM4BLeSg`).
- **Out-of-flow `top: 100%` selection skirt:** Overlaps `~82 px` across the `13.5 px` row gap onto row `N+1`'s cover and steals pointer hits (`DC_kwDODSospM4BLeSg`).
- **Unnamed `@container` inside `.content`:** `.content` declares its own `container-type: inline-size` (`List.css:62`), which shadows an unnamed ancestor container query unless `ul.portal-examples-list` uses a named container (`examples-list`).
- **Hardcoded `+3` arrow-key stride:** Breaks on `Featured`'s `2×2` `leadCard` (`card 1` at col 3 row 1 sits directly above `card 2` at col 3 row 2, not `card 4`).

**The operator's clarification on this ticket's premise (20 Nov, in session with me).** He liked the old gradient blending, and hover must not look like focus/selected. But he did not say we must or should use the old gradients: "i only challenged the team to do better." The title ("Restore … gradients") and Fix 3's palette (`#3E63DD` blue, `#1f7a4c` green, their composite) read the veto as a restoration order. My `[GRADUATION_APPROVED]` endorsed that reading, and I retract it for the look. It still stands for the interaction contract: two zones, the stationary footer, the hit-owner rule, the selection model and the `@container` split.

**A proposal for "better": one hover grammar for both Portal card families.** #21674 ships the glass cards' hover, picked by the operator from frames. On entry, one glint crosses the glass and one lap of light runs the border; then the card rests lit, and nothing moves. Its `@property` angle and both keyframes are global in `resources/css/src/apps/portal/Viewport.css`, so the example cards can reuse them as they are.
- **Hover is light passing over the cover.** The glint crosses the cover image and the lap runs the card's border. No wash parks on the image, and the cover shows in full.
- **Selected/focused is a state that stays.** A steady accent ring, a tint blended into the cover through `@property` and `overlay` (the part he liked), and the details band.
- **Hovered + selected** is the selected state with the hover's light passing over it. It stays distinct without a third palette.

Each state differs in kind, motion against persistence, not only in hue. Show it as candidates beside the restored palette in the 4-state frames, so he picks from better options rather than signing off one.

## Design ruling for AC-1 and AC-3: the pointer reflects, the selection glows

**Authority.** The operator, 21 Nov, in session with me: "You are in charge for the example overviews design", and on the three candidates: "you are NOT limited to choose from them. think about what is best => impressive." This replaces AC-1's clause that he selects from A, B and C. The interaction contract of Discussion #21670 stands as built on `dadd39c03f`: two zones, the stationary footer, the selection model, the `@container` split.

**The look.** Two cursors share this grid, the pointer and the selection the arrow keys move. Each answers in its own kind, not only in its own colour.

| | Pointer over the card | Selected |
|---|---|---|
| Kind | light from outside | light the card emits |
| On entry | one glint crosses the cover, as on the home's glass cards (#21674) | a ring draws itself from the upper right corner down both sides and stays; deselecting opens it again |
| Edge | 1.5 px blue, fades | 2 px green ring, a soft glow |
| Cover | a blue light rests in the upper right, mixed into the image | as captured above the details; a green light only at the details' edge |
| "Open live" | a filled blue pill | a green outline |
| Details | closed | open |

Both at once is both at once: the ring leads in blue and closes in green, both lights fall, the pill carries both colours. Keyboard focus is a neutral ring, selected or not, so blue stays the pointer's and green the selection's. Blue is `--sem-color-border-focus`, green is the neo themes' own `--green` scale.

![the look](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/debfb4398ec8c516d74abd12cfce113b4180b9ef/review-evidence/21676/look-21676.jpg?raw=true)

**Why not A, B or C.** A washes the whole cover, which hides the product on the card the visitor is looking at, and separates the two states by hue only. B's hover is motion only: its board had to freeze the sweep to show it, and a hover needs a resting answer. C's hover is the right idea and is kept (a focal light, a lit launch pill); its selected state is A's wash.

**The patch**, on top of `dadd39c03f`: [`21676-look.diff`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/debfb4398ec8c516d74abd12cfce113b4180b9ef/review-evidence/21676/21676-look.diff) (4 files, +257 −88; `git apply --check` passes).
